article: Culture is all of our business
stem: During a quarterly risk review, a chief compliance officer identifies staff surveys indicating reluctance to raise concerns despite strong policy-completion figures. Which recommendation BEST addresses ethical culture?
options: Test speak-up and leadership behaviors, address local barriers, but defer tracking whether employee experience improves until after management considers the matter closed.
Test speak-up and leadership behaviors, address local barriers, and track whether employee experience improves.
Focus exclusively on increasing the annual policy attestation rate.
Assume a high helpline volume proves employees feel safe reporting.
explanation: The best choice is to test speak-up and leadership behaviors, address local barriers, and track whether employee experience improves. This approach focuses on ethical culture rather than relying on an untested shortcut. The other options either substitute assertions for evidence, postpone assessment, or weaken accountability. Editorial basis: CEP 2025-11, Culture is all of our business, p. 22; verify the precise article passage before using this in a scored mock exam.
